summary: Console interleaved trace links after concurrent tracehook configuration change during live backfill
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reported that dashboard rows in their Organization's Alerts view sometimes open the wrong trace when clicking the trace link. The wrong trace appears to belong to an adjacent row (off-by-one), specifically during a window when the customer ran a backfill job and simultaneously updated tracing hook headers via the Console.

Impact:
- Multiple users at NovaLogix saw incorrect trace context in alert drilldowns for ~45 minutes.
- Misattribution caused engineers to investigate the wrong request for live incidents.
- No data loss reported; primarily an incorrect mapping/linking problem.

Environment:
- Redwood Console (hosted) serving NovaLogix dedicated org; prod-us-east.
- Backfill process running against historical ingest (kinesis->ingest-job v2).
- Tracehook update issued by customer via Console (header size/config change) during the same time window.

Steps to reproduce (customer):
1) Start a historical backfill for an org (ingest-job v2).
2) While backfill is running, change tracehook config in Console: toggle proxy header rewrite and update a custom header key.
3) Refresh Dashboards -> Alerts. Click trace link in alert row A; observed trace belongs to row B (adjacent).

Observed logs / snippets:
- console-service logs: "trace_link_anchor=tn-000123 mapped_to=tn-000122 (expected tn-000123)"
- ingest-backfill: "row_id=5698 assigned_anchor_index=42"
- browser console (customer): "traceLinkHref: /trace/tn-000122 for rowIndex=43"

Hypothesis:
- Concurrent mutation of tracehook metadata (header rewrite/key) during backfill caused temporary reordering of trace anchor tokens. The console UI relies on a row->anchor position mapping that assumed stable ordering. When the anchor list was rebuilt during the backfill+config-update, some indexes shifted and the UI rendered stale link tokens for a short window.

Immediate impact mitigation guidance provided to customer:
- Workaround: refresh the Dashboard after config changes or wait for backfill to complete before toggling tracehook settings.
- If urgent: temporarily pause backfill via admin API until tracehook migration completes.

Attachments provided by customer:
- 3 screenshot PNGs showing mismatched trace ids and adjacent rows (attached in ticket).
- Console HAR file capturing click and returned trace id.

Next steps (internal):
1) Reproduce in staging with controlled backfill + tracehook change sequence.
2) Add guard in Console that validates anchor tokens on render; fallback to re-fetch anchors on mismatch.
3) Patch ingest-backfill to emit stable anchor UUIDs that are not position-dependent during concurrent rebuilds.
4) Add integration test to synth test suite for simultaneous backfill + config update.

Related artifacts:
- Slack thread: #support (link: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C07SUPPORT/p1689001234000)
- Suspected linked internal issue: INT-4421 (anchor-rewrite-race)
- Initial reproducer PR planned: GH PR #67321

investigation_notes: Reproducer created in local: simulate kinesis batch reorder + tracehook config POST during job run; observed off-by-one mapping in rendered trace links.
Console code path: renderAlertRow -> fetchAnchors() caches anchors by index; does not verify anchor ids before constructing link href.
Backfill path: anchor tokens were computed as sha1(job_run_id + position). When position shifts, tokens remain but mapping to rows changes if UI cached older positions.
Potential race: config change triggers prefetch of updated anchor list while UI still has stale index mapping; race window ~30-90s depending on backfill throughput.
resolution_notes: Workaround accepted by customer (pause/refresh). Engineering patch to stabilize anchor tokens merged to staging PR #67321. Console will be updated to validate anchor ids on row render; fallback to fetch-by-id if mismatch. Plan: deploy staging 2026-03-14, run integration tests, schedule prod deploy 2026-03-18 with monitoring dashboard to watch trace-link mismatches. After prod deploy, SRE to run synthetic backfill+config-change test against NovaLogix org to confirm. Close ticket post-verification.
